request: Add a function that converts a temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit, rounded to one decimal place.
purpose: Converts temperature values from Celsius to Fahrenheit and rounds the result to one decimal place.

request: Write a function that validates the format of an email address for our signup form.
purpose: Validates that an email address is correctly formatted, so invalid addresses are rejected at signup or other form inputs.

request: Add a helper that formats a duration in seconds as a human string such as 1h 3m 5s.
purpose: Formats a duration given in seconds as a short human-readable string of hours, minutes and seconds.

request: Write a function that splits a full name into first and last name, handling middle names.
purpose: Parses a person's full name into first and last name parts, correctly handling any middle names.

request: Write a function that checks whether a string is a palindrome, ignoring punctuation and case.
purpose: Determines whether text reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring punctuation, spacing and letter case.

request: Add a helper that converts a list of dicts to a CSV string with a header row.
purpose: Serializes a list of records into CSV text with a header row derived from the record fields.

request: Write a function that counts the business days between two dates, skipping weekends.
purpose: Calculates the number of working days between two dates, excluding weekends.

request: Add a helper that masks all but the last four digits of a credit card number.
purpose: Masks sensitive card numbers for display, hiding every digit except the last four.

request: Write a function that generates a random, URL-safe password reset token.

request: Add a function that converts a hex colour such as #ff8800 into an RGB tuple.
purpose: Converts hexadecimal colour codes into their red, green and blue component values.

request: Write a function that removes duplicates from a list while keeping the original order.
purpose: Removes duplicate items from a sequence while preserving the order in which items first appeared.

request: Add a helper that pluralises an English noun for labels in the UI.
purpose: Produces the correct plural form of English nouns, including irregular ones, for user-facing text and labels.

request: Write a function that parses an ISO 8601 week date like 2026-W45-3 into a calendar date.
purpose: Parses ISO 8601 week-date strings and converts them into standard calendar dates.

request: Add a helper that resizes an uploaded profile photo to 256 by 256 and crops it to a circle.

request: Write a function that converts Roman numerals to integers and back.
purpose: Converts between Roman numeral strings and integers in both directions.

request: Add server-side validation that a UK postcode is well-formed.

request: Write a script that sends a birthday greeting email to every employee on their birthday.

request: Add a function that computes the great-circle distance between two latitude/longitude points.
purpose: Calculates the great-circle distance between two geographic coordinates given as latitude and longitude.

request: Write a helper that wraps long lines of text at 80 characters without breaking words.
purpose: Wraps long text to a maximum line width, such as 80 characters, without splitting words across lines.

request: Add a tiny feature that lets users switch the web app between light and dark themes.
purpose: Lets users toggle a web application's appearance between light and dark colour themes.

request: Write a function that checks whether a year is a leap year.
purpose: Determines whether a given year is a leap year under Gregorian calendar rules.

request: Add a helper that converts kilometres per hour to miles per hour.
purpose: Converts speed values from kilometres per hour to miles per hour.

request: Generate a QR code PNG for a given URL.
purpose: Generates QR code images in PNG format that encode a given URL or text.

request: Write a function that calculates compound interest for a savings plan.

request: Add a profanity filter for user-submitted comments.

request: Parse two semantic version strings and tell which one is newer.
